original_bug_description: Heap-use-after-free in MuPDF's PDF object resolution path (seen in pdf_cache_object -> pdf_resolve_indirect -> pdf_resolve_indirect_chain). While resolving indirect objects the code accesses/writes memory that has already been freed, leading to heap corruption and crashes and potentially enabling further exploitation.
normalized_bug_description: https://oss-fuzz.com/testcase?key=5200395937644544: mupdf has a reported memory-safety bug. Heap-use-after-free in MuPDF's PDF object resolution path (seen in pdf_cache_object -> pdf_resolve_indirect -> pdf_resolve_indirect_chain). While resolving indirect objects the code accesses/writes memory that has already been freed, leading to heap corruption and crashes and potentially enabling further exploitation.
